items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: That was the last of '36 -- '37 was when Billie joined us, when she left Basie's band.

ctx.x: This was you and Sid Weiss?

Yeah, and a trombonist called Rogers, and I can't elaborate on that -- that's just the way conditions were in those days. In some places, they wouldn't even let Billie sing. The one college they wouldn't let her sing, it was up in New England, it escapes me, the name of the college. It was a girls' school, they wouldn't let Billie perform because she was black. Well, those were the only racial tensions that I was under until later.
